mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 over the past two months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling a weakening economy and triggering risk-off behavior in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 94.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 226.0 over the past two months signals accelerating inflation, increasing the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed, which raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 226.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 9.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 131,300 thousand signals a labor market collapse, increasing recession risk and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 395,000 million dollars over the past month, combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST) below 570 thousand units, indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, leading to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 combined with a drop in real GDP (GDPC1) below 13,270 billion dollars signals a broad-based economic contraction, increasing the probability of a recession and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
